t: This is the Tower House at 29 Melbury Road, a red brick townhouse with a distinctive round tower and a conical roof. The architect William Burges built it as his own home, designing it between 1875 and 1881 in the French Gothic Revival style, and he died here in 1881. One historian called its interior the most complete medieval secular interior the Gothic Revival produced, and the last. It has been Grade I listed since 1949. Later on, the Irish actor Richard Harris lived here.
